test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The sum of two numbers m and n is 84 (m > n) and their difference is 6. What is the ratio of the two numbers?
solution:
Given:

Sum of two numbers m and n = 84

Difference is 6 

Calculation:

m + n = 84 ----(1)

m - n = 6 ----(2)

On adding equation (1) and (2), We get

m + n + m - n = 84 + 6

⇒ 2m = 90 

⇒ m = 45

By putting the value of m in equation (1)

⇒ n = 39

According to question,

Ratio of the two numbers = 45/39

⇒ m/n = 15/13

**∴ The ratio of the two numbers is 15/13.**
